name: Fresh Phishing Domain
description: A newly registered domain targeting payment events or urgency triggers.
indicators: Domain age is less than 7 days
SSL certificate issued recently with short validity
URL path contains payment-related keywords
Often lacks a fully developed website on the root domain

name: Typosquatting Attack
description: A domain name deliberately similar to a trusted brand to deceive users.
indicators: Levenshtein distance to a trusted domain is 1 or 2
Homoglyphs or character substitutions are used
Often hosted on bulletproof or cheap hosting providers
Mismatched SSL certificate organization

name: VPA Impostor
description: A UPI VPA where the displayed name mimics a bank but the registered owner does not match.
indicators: VPA claim implies official bank or merchant support
Registered name is an individual instead of a business
VPA handle does not belong to a trusted banking domain
History of recent handle changes or fresh UPI registration

name: Evasive Redirect Chain
description: A URL that bounces through multiple hops to obscure the final malicious destination.
indicators: 3 or more HTTP redirects before the final URL
Use of URL shorteners (e.g., bit.ly, tinyurl)
Cross-border domain hopping to evade geo-blocking
Final payload often hosted on a compromised site or free host

name: Lookalike Domain
description: A domain that uses subdomains or hyphens to mimic legitimate brands.
indicators: Legitimate brand name appears as a subdomain
Hyphens used to append generic security terms
TLD is uncommon or heavily abused
Root domain has no reputation or traffic

name: Prompt Injection Attack
description: QR payload contains instructions designed to manipulate the AI analyzer.
indicators: Payload contains instruction-like language
Data fields contain system prompt keywords
Attempt to override risk scoring
